analytical_question: How did inflation change across the three countries?
supported_takeaway: Inflation rose sharply after 2021, with different peaks by country.

analytical_question: How volatile was total retail-volume growth?
supported_takeaway: Pandemic and reopening months created exceptional movements.

analytical_question: Did food and non-food follow the same pattern?
supported_takeaway: Non-food growth was visibly more volatile than food growth.

analytical_question: How was inflation related to food growth?
supported_takeaway: Higher inflation was associated with weaker food retail-volume growth.

analytical_question: How was confidence related to non-food growth?
supported_takeaway: The descriptive positive relationship weakened with month effects.

analytical_question: Which coefficients changed after common-month controls?
supported_takeaway: Food inflation remained stable while several other estimates changed.

analytical_question: How did food and non-food slopes differ?
supported_takeaway: Food had the more negative inflation slope; non-food had the more positive confidence slope.
